scope: One PX4/SITL calibration mission under current single-D435i official_ego policy. No formal N11-N16 count. Existing evidence is reused without repeating passed N01-N09 items.

hypothesis.one_primary_variable: Mission support horizon: extend the single-goal operating horizon from N09 short 0.4 m/approximately 37 sim seconds to a one-way 16 m target followed by a continuous 600 sim second active hold; keep the sensor, policy, planner profile, and PX4 control path fixed.
hypothesis.criterion: The native task must complete and independent truth must show position <=0.30 m, yaw <=15 deg for >=3.0 simulation seconds. The subsequent bridge-active hold must last >=600 simulation seconds with no localization/map/telemetry reset or stale/fault abort, followed by landed/disarmed readback. Candidate localization, speed, tracking and source-age bounds are evaluated separately and do not replace the mission criterion.
hypothesis.termination: Stop and invoke bridge-owned landing on localization invalid/stale, PX4 telemetry stale, sim clock regression/stall >15 wall seconds, action or hold watchdog, or any bridge phase leaving ACTIVE while airborne. Preserve all failed records.

raw_vio_position_error_max_m.basis: Half of the GOAL F 0.30 m arrival envelope, reserved as localization share before tracking; compared to N01 max ATE 0.06723 m.

raw_vio_yaw_error_max_deg.basis: Half of the GOAL F 15 degree yaw envelope; compared to N01 max yaw RMSE 0.4295 deg.

actual_vector_speed_max_m_s.basis: N08 low-speed measured vector peaks 0.07550-0.08282 m/s; current planner axis cap remains 0.10 m/s; independent truth speed decides.

tracking_error_max_m.basis: Existing runtime watchdog; N08 measured max 0.08008-0.08671 m at the same planner limits.

map_source_and_occupancy_age_max_sim_s.basis: Existing map freshness guard; N09 successful maximum source age 0.156 s, N03 idle query maximum 0.168 s.

localization_status_receipt_gap_max_wall.basis: Existing health supervisor guard; keep unchanged.

optimized_odometry_receipt_gap_max_wall_.basis: Existing health supervisor guard; keep unchanged.

not_covered_by_this_run: Obstacle geometry and minimum true body-to-obstacle clearance; derive from the existing body plus provisional uncertainty budget and obtain an official-policy obstacle calibration before freeze.
End-to-end replan response after a newly occupied voxel under PX4 execution; planner-only #118 is not used as flight latency evidence.
Formal N16 complete-load task, formal N11-N16 run counts, and fault-injection repetitions.

prior_rtf_evidence.source: N09 official_ego repeat01-repeat04 truth and bridge timeline artifacts
prior_rtf_evidence.watchdog_basis: At the observed 0.740-0.747 RTF, the 1500 s action and 2400 s hold watchdogs each retain about 3.0x margin. At RTF=0.3, they retain 1.25x and 1.2x. A stalled ROS simulation clock independently aborts after 15 wall seconds.
